items.title: ZDI-CAN-28762: Flowise
items.description: A CVSS score 8.1 AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H severity vulnerability discovered by 'Nicholas Zubrisky (@NZubrisky) of TrendAI Research' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-02-19, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-06-19 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
